description: A small counter in the title bar: how many of your agents are working and how many are waiting for you. Open its menu to jump to any of them.

scopes.agent:read: See which coding agents are running in your terminals and whether they wait for you.
scopes.terminal:read: Find which tab holds an agent's terminal, so the menu can take you there.
scopes.workspace:write: Switch to an agent's tab when you pick it from the menu.
